mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% in a month, but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.2% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.2%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO (both down > 0.5% from prior month) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising wage pressures and inflation expectations that prompt aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0 thousand units signals reduced consumer confidence and lower residential investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1300.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% for three consecutive months compresses the equity risk premium and reduces long-term growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over any 3-year rolling window, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS has been above 2.5% for the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 500,000 million dollars, it indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 500,000 million dollars, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of such months.
